SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA.title: Stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA.description: Spent by attacks. Below half: Tired (−25% attack damage). Not enough for the attack: Exhausted (−50%) and you lose 2 HP per missing point. Regenerates each turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MANA.title: Mana
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MANA.description: Spent by spells. Every hero has Mana; how much a spell costs depends on your mastery of its school. Regenerates each turn.
STAR_COUNT.title: Mana ✦
STAR_COUNT.description: Mana (shown as Stars). Spells cost ✦; every hero has Mana. Combat starts with half your pool; each turn you regain ✦ up to the pool, and unspent ✦ carries over.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA_BAR.title: ◆ Stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAMINA_BAR.description: {Amount} of {Pool}, +{Regen} each turn. Attacks cost ◆; below half — [gold]Tired[/gold] (−25%), not enough for an attack — [gold]Exhausted[/gold] (−50%) and 2 HP per missing ◆.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MANA_BAR.title: ✦ Mana
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATE_TIRED.title: Tired
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATE_TIRED.description: Less than half of the ◆ pool: attacks deal 25% less damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATE_EXHAUSTED.title: Exhausted
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STATE_EXHAUSTED.descripti: No ◆ left: attacks deal 50% less damage and each missing ◆ costs 2 HP.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENEMY_STAMINA.title: ◆ Enemy stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENEMY_STAMINA.description: {Amount} of {Pool}, +{Regen} at the end of its turn. Attacks cost ◆ (multi-hit and heavy ones — 2). Low ◆ weakens its attacks; at 0 it [gold]Catches its breath[/gold] ({Block} Block, full ◆) instead of attacking. Frost and Chill drain ◆.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENEMY_MANA.title: ✦ Enemy mana
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ENEMY_MANA.description: {Amount} of {Pool}, +{Regen} at the end of its turn. Its attacks are spells and cost ✦; without mana it [gold]Focuses[/gold] (Ward, full ✦). Shock and Static burn ✦ and break its spells.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN.title: ⚖ Burden
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN.description: Weight {Weight} of {Capacity}. Cards and relics weigh 1–2, equipment — by item, starting relics — 0.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN_OK.title: No overload
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN_LIGHT.title: Overload +{Excess}
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN_HEAVY.title: Heavy overload +{Excess}
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN_CRUSHING.title: Crushing overload +{Excess}
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BURDEN_CRUSHING.descripti: Overload {Excess} (above 10): ◆ regeneration −{StaminaPenalty}, opening hand −{HandPenalty} card, you cannot pick up anything until you drop something.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RELIC_WEIGHT.title: Weight
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RELIC_REWORK_ENERGY.title: Reworked
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RELIC_REWORK_ENERGY.descr: Energy relic: in Requiem it also costs −1 regeneration of your main resource — ◆ for the Platebearer and the Silent, ✦ for the Regent.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_COMBO_STEAM.title: Combo: Steam
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_COMBO_STEAM.descript: With the Pyromancer's Ring and the Ring of Hoarfrost: when a target has both [gold]Burning[/gold] and [gold]Chill[/gold], both are removed and it takes their sum as damage, ignoring resistances.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_COMBO_QUICKFURY.desc: With the Ring of Quick Breath and the Ring of Fury Strike: attacks that cost 0 ◆ deal 2 more damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_COMBO_CLEARVICEROY.d: With the Ring of Clear Mind and the Viceroy's Ring: the Viceroy's replay works twice per combat.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARROW_MAP.title: Next elites
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.subtitle: Act {Act}: where does the road lead?
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.fateHint: Do not vote: your companions decide, or the variant rolled when the run began stays.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.rolledHint: Fate already leans this way: if nobody chooses, this door opens.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.FROZEN_BARROWS.rule: Bitter cold: every fight starts with Chill {Chill}. Warm up at a campfire to skip it for {Warmth} fights; frost resistance or freeze immunity protects you. Elites drop Claw Keys (up to {Keys} per act); a key opens a locked vault for {Gold} gold. Barrow darkness: the map shows only {Dark} rows ahead ({Sight} with night sight — a torch, the Omen of Shade, a night-sight potion).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.CLOCKWORK_DEPTHS.ru: Steam: every {Period}th round a vent burst inflicts Burning {Burning} on the heroes. Turn a valve on the map to stop the bursts for the next {Relief} fights — and to switch the steam pipes: one route opens, another closes.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.BLOOD_COURT.rules: Day and night: map rows alternate in blocks of {Block}. At night enemies have +{Hp}% HP, and every fight pays +{Gold} gold.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.STAR_TOWER.rules: Ley lines: some fights on the map lie on a ley line — there every hero starts the fight with +{Mana} ✦. Portals leap over a row — a fight always waits at the far end.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DOORS.heading: Two Doors
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_LEGEND.heading: Map marks
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_POCKET.text: Side pocket: a treasure off the branch
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_LAST_REST.name: Last rest
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_LAST_REST.text: A camp and a small soul gem, but the act boss gets +10% HP.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.SHRINE.name: Shrine
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.SHRINE.text: A Celestial's blessing, Redemption, the Temple shop. In Glory a Celestial Banner also grants the Heavenly Shield.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.DARK_ALTAR.name: Dark Altar
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.DARK_ALTAR.text: A gift of an Abyss Prince — at a price.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.HERBALIST.name: Herbalist
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.JEWELER.name: Jeweler
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.CARAVAN.name: Caravan
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.CARAVAN.text: A little of everything, exotic goods, barter.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.FENCE.name: Fence
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.TAVERN.name: Tavern
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.TAVERN.text: Food, rumours, the Mentor, a short rest.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LIBRARY.name: Library
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LIBRARY.text: Learn a spell, copy a scroll, buy a treatise.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LAIR.name: Lair
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LAIR.text: A lighter beast elite: reagents and hide armour.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.TRIAL.name: Trial
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.TRIAL.text: An empowered elite; an extra relic for the win.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.CACHE.name: Cache
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.CACHE.text: A chest with a lock (Claw Key) or a trap.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LOCKED_GATE.name: Locked Gate
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.LOCKED_GATE.text: A sealed vault: the path opens only with a Claw Key.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.VALVE.name: Valve
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.VALVE.text: Turning it switches the steam pipes and stops the bursts for a while.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.ABYSS_GATE.name: Abyss Gate
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.ABYSS_GATE.text: A fight with Abyss spawn: a relic or a soul gem.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.MEMORY_STONE.tex: Rollback point: the Imprint of the act.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.EBB_STONES.name: Ebb Stones
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.EBB_STONES.text: Six stones by the water: Ebb Shards.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.AMBUSH.name: Ambush
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_NODE.AMBUSH.text: Enemies strike first and harder; gold after the fight. Seen only with night sight.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_GROUP.FAITH.name: Faith
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_GROUP.DANGER.name: Danger
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_GROUP.NATURE.name: Nature and craft
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_GROUP.MAGIC.name: Magic
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PORTAL.name: Portal
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PORTAL.text: Leaps over a row; a fight always waits at the far end.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PIPE.name: Steam pipe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PIPE.text: Open: a valve can close it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PIPE_CLOSED.name: Closed pipe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.PIPE_CLOSED.text: Impassable until a valve opens it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.SECRET.name: Secret trail
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.SECRET.text: Seen and walked only with night sight, the Barrow Map or the Omen of the Trickster.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.DANGER.name: Dangerous trail
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.DANGER.text: A shortcut to an elite or an ambush — a cache waits after the fight.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.POCKET.name: Side pocket
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.POCKET.text: A dead-end treasure off the branch; returns to it one row later.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.LOCKED.name: Locked gate
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.LOCKED.text: The way into a vault: needs a Claw Key.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.LAST_REST.name: Last rest
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MAP_EDGE.LAST_REST.text: A camp and a soul gem, but the boss gets +10% HP.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DISCARD_NOT_THIS.title: Basic cards, curses, statuses and Eternal cards cannot be dropped — remove them at a shop or event.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DISCARD_NOT_OVERLOADED.ti: You can drop cards only while overloaded. To thin the deck, use card removal at a shop.
